issues.legal_issue: An owner governed by Mohammedan law cannot partition property between himself and his heirs during his lifetime.
A valid oral gift under Mohammedan law requires a clear declaration of intent by the donor, acceptance by or on behalf of the donee, and delivery of possession.
A mutation entry describing a transaction as a partition does not establish an intention to make a gift when its wording does not show a clear and unequivocal declaration of gift.
Mutation entries in revenue records do not create or confer title to property.
